answer: Price fakes by forcing each new identity to prepay a decaying work bond and to collect independent on-ledger receipts before rewards vest. An attacker who spins up a thousand shells must fund a thousand walnut deposits and keep them locked through the delay; early exit slashes the deposit. Honest raters only countersign after spending a scarce quill from a per-epoch attestation budget, so farms cannot buy cheap rubber stamps. The resulting cost mesa rises almost linearly with the herd size, which is what removes the usual volume discount on sybil identities.
